description: This file contains C source code implementing BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) related functionalities, including loading BPF modules, managing BPF maps and programs, setting debug handlers, and interacting with eBPF objects via libbpf. It defines functions, data structures, and constants for BPF operations within a larger system, likely a scripting or runtime environment that interfaces with BPF.

classes.name: uc_bpf_fd
classes.description: Structure representing a BPF file descriptor with a close flag.

classes.name: uc_bpf_map
classes.description: Structure representing a BPF map with associated file descriptor and key/value sizes.

classes.name: uc_bpf_map_iter
classes.description: Iterator structure for traversing BPF map keys.

methods.name: set_error
methods.description: Sets the last error message and code, formatting the message with printf-style arguments.

methods.name: init_env
methods.description: Initializes environment limits for BPF operations, such as memlock limits.

methods.name: uc_bpf_error
methods.description: Returns the last BPF error message or code, formatted as a string or integer.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_set_opts
methods.description: Configures BPF module options, such as setting initial values for maps and program types.

methods.name: uc_bpf_open_module
methods.description: Loads a BPF module from a file, with optional configuration, returning a resource handle.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_create
methods.description: Creates a BPF map resource with specified file descriptor and sizes.

methods.name: uc_bpf_open_map
methods.description: Opens an existing BPF map by path, returning a map resource.

methods.name: uc_bpf_open_program
methods.description: Opens a BPF program by path, returning a program resource.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_maps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of map names from a BPF module.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_map
methods.description: Retrieves a specific map resource by name from a BPF module.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_programs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of program names from a BPF module.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_program
methods.description: Retrieves a specific program resource by name from a BPF module.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_get
methods.description: Gets a value from a BPF map by key.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_set
methods.description: Sets a value in a BPF map by key.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_delete
methods.description: Deletes a key from a BPF map, optionally returning the value.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_delete_all
methods.description: Deletes all keys from a BPF map, optionally filtering with a callback.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_iterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator for traversing BPF map keys.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_iter_next
methods.description: Gets the next key from a BPF map iterator.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_iter_next_int
methods.description: Gets the next key as an integer from a BPF map iterator.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all keys in a BPF map, calling a callback for each.

methods.name: uc_bpf_obj_pin
methods.description: Pins a BPF object (map or program) to a filesystem path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_program_pin
methods.description: Pins a BPF program to a filesystem path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_pin
methods.description: Pins a BPF map to a filesystem path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_set_tc_hook
methods.description: Sets up a traffic control hook for a network interface with specified type and priority.

methods.name: uc_bpf_program_tc_attach
methods.description: Attaches a BPF program to a traffic control hook.

methods.name: uc_bpf_tc_detach
methods.description: Detaches a BPF program from a traffic control hook.

methods.name: uc_bpf_debug_print
methods.description: Custom print function for libbpf debug output, forwarding to a scripting environment.

methods.name: uc_bpf_set_debug_handler
methods.description: Sets a custom debug handler for libbpf output.

methods.name: register_constants
methods.description: Registers BPF-related constants into the scripting environment scope.

methods.name: uc_module_init
methods.description: Initializes the BPF module, registering functions, constants, and types.
